mapper.select: SELECT h.EMPNO AS empno, h.EMP_NM AS empNm, h.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, h.PART_CD AS partCd FROM HR_DEVELOPER h WHERE h.EMPNO = #{empno} AND h.STATUS_CD = '01'
SELECT h.EMPNO AS empno, h.EMP_NM AS empNm, h.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, h.PART_CD AS partCd FROM HR_DEVELOPER h WHERE h.STATUS_CD = '01' AND h.DEPT_CD = #{dept} AND h.PART_CD = #{part} ORDER BY h.EMPNO
